title: The Promise of Sandpiper Point Anew
author: Beatrix Okafor
blurb: Felix Ashgrove, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
